counterevidence: Several facts favour the canon's current framing: - The core already keeps the enclosure reading open and records Dear 025's necessity claim, and the CSL notes that 100Pro accepts both. - P's deference is brief and resolves once Asari speaks. - The rupture spans Dear 022–026 and is fully repaired. - P remains the schedule/opportunity authority, so the power asymmetry is real.
strongest_defense: The core accurately records the decisive choice: Dear 025 `ボクには…必要` / `ボクらしい選択`. On this view the anger, apology and P's hesitation are narrative texture, and Producer-side development belongs in RS-II, not a Mao character core. The finding survives this defence: - The omission is total. Search finds no 約束/promise for Mao–P, and none of the Dear 022 outburst, P's acquiescence or Asari's lesson, in any core, matrix, ledger, synthesis or AV home. - Both primary readers found it independently, on disjoint partitions (Dear/communications versus Produce). - It answers falsification targets the core itself leaves open (matrix §3 target 3; MAO-C25). - It changes the evidential basis of the §8.5 enclosure argument. proposed_change: Add a CORE §6 subsection on the bilateral mechanics of the romance, with four points. (1) A recurrent sequence: her bid, then his professional reframing, then her deflation or protest, sometimes followed by his correction. Instances: cidol-000_02 L120 (manga for a date); cidol-001_01 L206; cidol-002_02 L187–229; dear_009 L324–365; dear_010 L347–390; dear_026 L405–437; P2 before-a-normal-01 L58–68; activity_010 L71–75; P1 ending-true L150–156. (2) The sibling/training frame works as a pretext both of them use: dear_006 lap pillow ("訓練、でしょ？"); dear_009 head-pat branch "それもあります"; dear_011 reinforcement week; dear_024 "弟" as a cover label before her family. When dear_020 L103–105 and L410 retire the frame, she asks for closeness as herself (L414). (3) His attachment surfaces only obliquely: dear_009 L307 then L317 "冗談です"; cidol-008_02 L153 sleep-talk; dear_020 L436–437; tears in dear_037; and the hidden "――はい" (L453). (4) Revise C10: the fusion is co-produced, because her vow adopts the professional idiom he repeatedly supplied (dear_010 訓練 toward Prima Stella; dear_026 office in her hometown; dear_027 "娘さんをください" glossed as "トップアイドルにします"; P1 "ファン1号さん"). Downgrade AVB §12 and RELL "explicit lover" to: Rinami's explicit love, plus a lifelong commitment he accepts through a hidden single-option choice; mutual romantic love is suggested, not stated. Add an open question on the Producer's side.
alternative_interpretation: His reframing is principled professional restraint, protecting her from the scandal that Dear 015 shows to be a real risk, rather than deflection or obliviousness. The hidden "はい" is the game's convention for player assent and is meant to carry mutual love. On this reading, "Rinami herself fuses" is accurate because the vow's wording is hers.
counterevidence: He sometimes corrects course and takes personal initiative: cidol-002_02 L187–229, cidol-001_02 aquarium gift, dear_016 L182 protective anger in a sibling idiom. dear_026 L412 "それも悪くない" and dear_020 L437 can be read as reciprocal feeling. The father scene (dear_027 L13) is comic.
strongest_defense: The core is Rinami's home, and the Producer is a player-avatar whose interior is conventionally underwritten. The core already treats his professional authority as an ethical variable (§6, RINAMI-C25, OQ-RINAMI-03) and avoids claiming literal marriage. Its fusion claim concerns the wording of Rinami's vow, which is hers. "Genuinely reciprocal" can be read as reciprocity of care, which the text supports. The finding survives this defence for three reasons. The reframing pattern recurs in at least fifteen scenes across four source families, is the main dramatic engine of the pairing, and appears in no canonical home. AVB §12 and RELL assert a romantic mutuality the text withholds. And attributing the fusion solely to Rinami omits that the Producer supplied the professional idiom of her vow throughout.
reviewer_reasoning: The defense does not survive the recurrence. The bid-then-reframe sequence appears in at least eleven scenes, five of them in the C1 Dear chain (009 L307-L365; 010 L347-L390; 020 L410-L437; 026 L405-L437; 027 L13-L18). It is how the route builds the romance-production fusion the core treats as central, and the core explains that fusion without it. That is a significant relational feature insufficiently incorporated, so P1. Qualifications: (1) C10: do not replace 'by Rinami herself'. Supplement it: the wording is Rinami's chosen language, and it takes up the production idiom the Producer kept supplying (training toward Prima Stella, office in her hometown, 'make her a top idol', 'fan No.1'); the fusion is co-produced in idiom and authored by her in voice. (2) AVB s12 and relationship-ledger row 316: scope rather than downgrade. Write 'Rinami's explicit love; his acceptance through a hidden one-option はい; his romantic reciprocity strongly implied (dear_009 L307, 008_02 L153, dear_020 L436-L437, tears at dear_037 L65-L85) but never voiced'. Leave 'suggested' out, and mark the AV dependency for anything stronger. (3) Keep motive OPEN (obliviousness, restraint, or both). 001_01 L206 shows sincere obliviousness in at least one scene. (4) Label branch-only lines (activity_010 choices 1 and 3; dear_009 choice 1) in any ledger entry.
